theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (F₀ : Set (Euclid (m + 1))) (v : Euclid (m + 1)), ‖v‖ = 1 → MeasurableSet F₀ → (∀ ζ : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → ∀ w : Euclid (m + 1), inner ℝ w v = 0 → ∫ z in F₀, fderiv ℝ ζ z w = 0) → (∀ ζ : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → (∀ z, 0 ≤ ζ z) → ∫ z in F₀, fderiv ℝ ζ z v ≤ 0) → volume F₀ = 0 ∨ volume F₀ᶜ = 0 ∨ ∃ c : ℝ, volume (symmDiff F₀ {z | c < inner ℝ z v}) = 0
